data.name: Abhimanyu
data.gender_notes: Abhimanyu is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit abhi, 'towards, over', + man, 'to think' — 'heroic, self-existent'. Its root is Sanskrit abhi + man. Abhimanyu, son of Arjuna in the Mahabharata. Abhimanyu is a Sanskrit name meaning “Heroic; self-existent; fearless”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Abhimanyu expresses “Heroic; self-existent; fearless”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit abhi, 'towards, over', + man, 'to think' — 'heroic, self-existent'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Abhimanyu total 40, reducing to 4. Number 4 is associated with discipline, order and steady effort.
